title: TNT Dome 7 Key
subtitle: Two keycards, a passcode and a timed secret door for TNT Dome 7

sections.title: How to Start
sections.html: There's no quest to start. The trail begins in the Kanawha Nuka-Cola Plant. You'll want lockpicking, power armour or a jetpack, and the Marsupial mutation helps with the climb.

sections.title: TNT Dome 7 Key Walkthrough
sections.html:
Step 1 – Go into the Kanawha Nuka-Cola Plant

Use the same entrance as for Dome 3: road north over the bridge, right at the Nuka-Cola sign, through the car park and in the door on your left.

Step 2 – Pick the level 0 door

Inside, face west through the double doorway and go past the stairs. The level 0 locked door on your left is a bathroom.

Step 3 – Take Paired Keycard 01

Step into the toilet stall and close the door. Paired Keycard 01 is on the floor behind the stall door, against the left wall. While you're in the plant, look for a note in the tasting area.

My Advice

Friend,

My advice to you is hide the thing. Marketing sees EVERYTHING, especially where their money has gone, and there is going to be a budget related firestorm... which lands squarely on you! And me for that matter since I'm about to help you.

I know a place you can stash it, out of sight out of mind. I'll adjust the lines on the expenditures sheets and no one will be the wiser. Don't take any chances, for both our sakes.

I'll take one key with me to Tanagra when I visit the kids. I've left the other one for you. It's in that place where I put that thing that time.

Step 4 – Go to Tanagra Town

Fast travel to Tanagra Town. The next keycard is at the very top, so power armour or a jetpack helps.

Step 5 – Walk through the vines

Walk through the vines and debris; no jumping needed.

Step 6 – Cross the bus and containers

Go over the school bus and along the shipping containers.

Step 7 – Climb the pipe

Go over the trailer bed and container, then up the pipe to another school bus.

Step 8 – Go through the school bus

Climb into the second school bus and walk through it.

Step 9 – Walk along the car

At the end of the bus is a car joined to a tree log. Walk to the end of the car.

Step 10 – Follow the log up

Turn left onto the log and follow it up.

Step 11 – Climb to the top floor

Go into the house at the top and jump up to the top floor.

Step 12 – Jump the gap in the floor

From the doorway, carefully jump the gap in the floor. Careful: you can knock the keycard off the building.

Step 13 – Find the flag

Look for a straw pillow, a folded American flag and a flat basketball.

Step 14 – Take Pairing Keycard 02

Pairing Keycard 02 is under the flag.

Step 15 – Go to the Crashed Plane

Fast travel to the Crashed Plane in the Mire and stand under the plane.

Attention: Nuka Cola Technician

Nuka-Cola Corporation Security Department

We regret to inform you that you are hereby immediately terminated for breach of contract and wanton disregard for the profit margins of Nuka-Cola.

It has come to our attention that you are responsible for the theft and resale of proprietary Nuka-Cola property. We demand that you return all stolen property, promotional products, passcodes, and novelty clothing items / weapons systems.

Furthermore, you must immediately destroy any unauthorized versions of the Nuka-Cola Marketing Systems you may have installed. Following that, we demand that you turn yourself in to the Nuka-Cola Security Enforcement Team. We appreciate your compliance in this matter.

Step 16 – Take the Nuka Cola Marketing Access Code

Stand on the blue suitcase on the metal shelves. Ahead is a brown suitcase and to your right, behind orange roots, a white one: the Nuka Cola Marketing Access Code is in it.

Step 17 – Go to Ingram Mansion

Fast travel to Ingram Mansion.

Step 18 – Walk down to the mansion

Follow the road down to the mansion and go round the back.

Step 19 – Find the terminal by the barbecue

The Nuka-Cola Marketing Systems terminal is on the desk by the barbecue.

Step 20 – Generate the one-time key

Choose Generate One-Time Key. It's a random 9-digit code that a new one cancels, so write it down. Without the marketing access code the terminal refuses you. This step can be buggy; if so, try another server or a private world.

Step 21 – Go to Overlook Cabin

Fast travel to Overlook Cabin in the Forest. The next part is on a timer, so read ahead first.

Step 22 – Go in the front door

Go in through the front door.

Step 23 – Go to the pool table

Turn right towards the kitchen, go through the double doorway on its left and stop at the near end of the pool table.

Step 24 – Go down to the black tank

Go through the doorway on your left, turn right and take the stairs down. Turn right and stand in the middle of the room facing a black tank with yellow signs.

Step 25 – Note the brick wall

Note the brick wall on your left, then go through the doorway on your right to the middle of the next room.

Step 26 – Find the red trunk

A red trunk is ahead, a brick wall on your left (remember it) and a pallet, safe and boxes on your right.

Step 27 – Swipe both keycards

Turn right to the wall: there are keycard readers to the left and right. Swipe keycard 01, then keycard 02.

Step 28 – Run to the hidden room

You have about 3 seconds: run to the brick wall on the other side of the room and into the side room that opens. Miss it and you'll need to server hop and do it again.

Step 29 – Enter the code

Enter your Ingram Mansion code on the keypad.

Step 30 – Press the big button

The door will have shut behind you: press the big button next to the keypad.

Step 31 – Run through the new door

Go back to the black-tank room. A door straight ahead is now open, also on a timer: run in.

Step 32 – Take TNT Dome Key 7

TNT Dome Key 7 sits on a pillar with a note.

Secret Door Sale!

Blowout Sale - Secret Crypt Doors! Right now, and for a limited time only! Buy two secret doors, get a third door free! You can't afford to miss out on this amazing offer!!*

*Offer does not include installation or delivery. Buyer must pay 35% convenience fee. Taxes and hidden fees apply. All three doors must be identical. See store for details. Not valid across state lines. Purchase of a door indicates an agreement to subscribe to one additional product per month. Reading this text authorizes us to sell your personal information. If you do not agree to these terms, you must unread this agreement.

sections.title: Finding the Dome
sections.html:
Step 33 – Go to Black Mountain Ordnance Works

Fast travel to Black Mountain Ordnance Works.

Step 34 – Find Dome 7

Face east and go through the bush to a big pile of rocks. Turn left and follow the rocks round to a green door: that's TNT Dome 7. The key opens it.

sections.title: Rewards
sections.html:
Inside TNT Dome 7:

  • Plan: X-01 Power Armor Nuka-Cola Quantum Paint on the corner of the desk on the left
  • Nuka-Cola Grape on the locker shelf by the power armour station, plus Nuka-Cola Quantum (3) and Cherry
  • A mini nuke, Gauss ammo and a box of bobby pins

sections.title: FAQ and Important Info
sections.html:
The hidden door closed before I got there. What now?

The doors are on a short timer. Server hop and swipe both keycards again, then run straight for it.

Is this a quest?

No. There's no quest and nothing in your Pip-Boy tracks it: the keys, notes and codes are the trail.

What about domes 1, 4, 5 and 6?

Their doors can't be opened. Notes for domes 5 and 6 exist in the game files but aren't placed anywhere, so they look like unfinished content.

sections.title: Lore
sections.html:
Black Mountain Ordnance Works is based on a real place, the West Virginia Ordnance Works. The records terminal in its main building (Cole & Parker Holdings LTD) has an entry for each dome; for domes 1, 4, 5 and 6 it only shows DATA READ ERROR.

Dome 7's entry has an undisclosed owner still waiting on the final contract, who was given early access and anonymity because of a large cash down payment.
